description: Infrastructures cyclables - Angers Loire Métropole is a dataset listed in Angers Loire Métropole - Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Angers Loire Métropole. Aménagements routiers dédiés au vélo sur le territoire d'Angers Loire Métropole Description des principaux champs du jeu de données NOM: nom de l’objet géographique VELOTYPE: type d’aménagement routier dédié au vélo CIRCULATIO: type de circulation LINEAIRE: longueur du tronçon en mètres DATEMAJ: date de mise à jour de la donnée Si la valeur DATEMAJ est ... Coverage: Angers Loire Métropole. The portal files it under Transports, Déplacements. Its keywords are vélo, Catalogue SIG. The portal shows 2,624 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-28 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is ODbL-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-angers-fr-portal.
